user.title: Set up Heating Manager
user.description:
Name your first heating zone (an area served by one boiler or heating circuit, e.g. Downstairs). It starts with a simple 06:30–22:00 schedule at 19°C.

Afterwards, use **Configure** on the integration to add rooms (TRVs and temperature sensors), edit schedules and change settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Heating Manager is already set up. Use Configure on the existing entry to add zones and rooms.
abort.already_configured: Heating Manager is already set up.

init.title: Heating Manager
init.description: Choose what to change. Changes are applied when you select **Save and close**.

data.fallback_mode: When a room's sensors are unavailable

data_description.minimum_temp: Target used when no schedule period is active.
data_description.frost_protection_temp: Target for every room while away mode is on.
data_description.heating_demand_mode: How a zone decides it needs heat: when any room is below target, or when the zone's average is below its average target. Zones can override this.
data_description.fallback_mode: Used when a room has no sensor reading from the last 30 minutes.
data_description.heating_deadband: Once a room has reached its target, how far it may cool before heating again. Smaller is tighter control but more cycling.
data_description.boost_duration: How long a boost lasts when no duration is given.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Defaults suit most homes; change these only if you know you need to.

data_description.update_interval: How often rooms are checked and TRVs updated.
data_description.trv_overshoot_enabled: Compensate for TRVs whose built-in sensor reads warmer than the room, by learning the difference and setting TRVs higher while a room heats. When off, TRVs are set to the room target.
data_description.trv_overshoot_max: Most a TRV setpoint is raised above target (plus learned offset) for a cold room. Increase if rooms heat slowly.
data_description.trv_overshoot_threshold: How far above target a room may get before its TRVs are set low to cool it.
data_description.trv_cooldown_offset: How far below target TRVs are set while a room is too warm.
data_description.trv_offset_ema_alpha: How quickly the learned TRV/room sensor difference follows new readings (higher = faster).
data_description.analytics_enabled: Track heating and cooling rates and estimate time to reach target.
data_description.analytics_history_size: Readings kept per room for analytics.
data_description.analytics_min_samples: Readings needed before rates are estimated.
data_description.derivative_smoothing_factor: Smoothing applied to heating/cooling rates (higher = more responsive).

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Pick a zone to edit its rooms and schedule, or add a new one.

data_description.heating_demand_mode: When this zone calls for heat. Its climate entity shows 'heating' then, for driving a boiler automation.
data_description.monitoring_only: Show this zone's room temperatures without heating: it never calls for heat (so it can't switch the boiler on) and its TRVs, if any, are left alone.

zone_delete.title: Delete {zone}?
zone_delete.description: This removes the zone, its rooms and their climate entities.

data.name: Name
data.configure_last_seen: Set 'last seen' sensors for the temperature sensors

data_description.trvs: Radiator valves in this room. They are set automatically.
data_description.sensors: Room temperature sensors (averaged). Place them away from radiators. Without one, the room uses the zone's fallback.
data_description.temperature_offset: Run this room warmer (+) or cooler (−) than the zone schedule. Doesn't apply to boost, away mode or a temperature set on the room itself.
data_description.configure_last_seen: Optional. For sensors with a separate timestamp entity (e.g. Zigbee2MQTT last_seen), to detect dead sensors more reliably.

room_last_seen.title: Last seen sensors for {room}
room_last_seen.description: For each temperature sensor, optionally pick the sensor holding when it last reported. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's own report time.

schedule.title: Schedule for {zone}
schedule.description: Weekdays are Monday–Friday; weekends are Saturday and Sunday.

schedule_day.title: {zone}: {day} schedule
schedule_day.description: Pick a period to edit or delete, or add one. Outside these periods the zone uses the 'temperature outside schedule' setting.

period.title: Schedule period ({day})
period.description: A period ending at or before its start runs past midnight (e.g. 22:00–06:00). Use 00:00 as the end for 'until midnight', or the same start and end for all day.

error.room_empty: Add at least one TRV or temperature sensor.
error.invalid_time: Enter valid start and end times.
error.overlap: This period overlaps another one on the same day.

options.last_known: Use the last reading, however old

yaml_imported.title: Heating Manager YAML configuration can be removed
yaml_imported.description:
Your Heating Manager configuration has been imported and is now managed in the UI (Settings → Devices & services → Heating Manager → Configure). Changes to the YAML are no longer used.

Remove the `heating_manager:` entry from configuration.yaml and delete {config_file}, then restart Home Assistant.
